Class Gdal

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.gdal.Gdal
public final class Gdal extends Object
GDAL for Java: the GDAL library of an installation (conda, Homebrew, the packages of Linux, QGIS, OSGeo4W) called with the Foreign Function and Memory API (Java 22+; no JNI library, no compiled code). 
Gdal.load();                                   // the installed GDAL (or Gdal.load(path))
try (GdalDataset ds = Gdal.open("dem.tif")) {
    float[] heights = ds.band(1).readFloats(); // row by row
    double[] gt = ds.geoTransform();           // the georeferencing
    String crs = ds.spatialReference().authority();  // e.g. "EPSG:32632"
}
Gdal.warp("dem.tif", "dem_wgs84.tif", "-t_srs", "EPSG:4326");   // the command line tools
Gdal.translate("dem.tif", "dem.png", "-of", "PNG", "-scale");
Gdal.vectorTranslate("roads.shp", "roads.gpkg", "-f", "GPKG");
All errors of GDAL are GdalExceptions (with the message of GDAL). Datasets, spatial references and transformations are AutoCloseable.
